name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q01 - Average rate calculation from reactant concentration decrease

questiontext.text:
For the reaction \(\text{R} \rightarrow \text{P}\), the concentration of reactant changes from \(0.030\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) to \(0.020\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) in \(25\ \text{minutes}\). What is the average rate of reaction in \(\text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\)?

अभिक्रिया \(\text{R} \rightarrow \text{P}\) के लिए, अभिकारक की सांद्रता \(25\ \text{मिनट}\) में \(0.030\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) से बदलकर \(0.020\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) हो जाती है। \(\text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\) में अभिक्रिया की औसत दर क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
The average rate of disappearance of reactant is: \[r_{\text{av}} = -\frac{\Delta [\text{R}]}{\Delta t} = -\frac{[\text{R}]_2 - [\text{R}]_1}{t_2 - t_1}\]

Step 2
Given \([\text{R}]_1 = 0.030\ \text{M}\), \([\text{R}]_2 = 0.020\ \text{M}\), and \(\Delta t = 25\ \text{min}\): \[r_{\text{av}} = -\frac{0.020 - 0.030}{25} = \frac{0.010}{25} = 4.0 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\]

Step 3
The average rate of the reaction is \(4.0 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
अभिकारक के लुप्त होने की औसत दर का सूत्र है: \[r_{\text{av}} = -\frac{\Delta [\text{R}]}{\Delta t} = -\frac{[\text{R}]_2 - [\text{R}]_1}{t_2 - t_1}\]

चरण 2
मान रखने पर: \[r_{\text{av}} = -\frac{0.020 - 0.030}{25} = \frac{0.010}{25} = 4.0 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\]

चरण 3
अभिक्रिया की औसत दर \(4.0 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q02 - Average rate conversion from minutes to seconds

questiontext.text:
For the reaction \(\text{R} \rightarrow \text{P}\), the concentration of reactant drops by \(0.010\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) in \(25\ \text{minutes}\). What is the average reaction rate in \(\text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\)?

अभिक्रिया \(\text{R} \rightarrow \text{P}\) के लिए, अभिकारक की सांद्रता \(25\ \text{मिनट}\) में \(0.010\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) घट जाती है। \(\text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\) में औसत अभिक्रिया दर क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Total elapsed time in seconds is: \[\Delta t = 25\ \text{min} \times 60\ \text{s}\ \text{min}^{-1} = 1500\ \text{s}\]

Step 2
Average rate with \(-\Delta [\text{R}] = 0.010\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\): \[r_{\text{av}} = \frac{0.010\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}}{1500\ \text{s}} = 6.67 \times 10^{-6}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\]

Step 3
The average reaction rate in SI units is \(6.67 \times 10^{-6}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
समय सेकंड में: \[\Delta t = 25 \times 60 = 1500\ \text{s}\]

चरण 2
सांद्रता परिवर्तन \(0.010\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) रखने पर: \[r_{\text{av}} = \frac{0.010}{1500} = 6.67 \times 10^{-6}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\]

चरण 3
औसत अभिक्रिया दर \(6.67 \times 10^{-6}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q03 - Overall reaction order from fractional exponents

questiontext.text:
A chemical reaction has the experimental rate expression \(\text{Rate} = k[\text{A}]^{1/2}[\text{B}]^{3/2}\). What is the overall order of this reaction?

एक रासायनिक अभिक्रिया का प्रायोगिक दर व्यंजक \(\text{दर} = k[\text{A}]^{1/2}[\text{B}]^{3/2}\) है। इस अभिक्रिया की समग्र कोटि क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
For a rate law \(\text{Rate} = k[\text{A}]^x[\text{B}]^y\), the overall order \(n\) is the sum of partial orders: \[n = x + y\]

Step 2
Summing exponents: \[n = \frac{1}{2} + \frac{3}{2} = \frac{4}{2} = 2\]

Step 3
The overall order of the reaction is 2 (second order).

चरण 1
दर नियम में समग्र कोटि सांद्रता पदों की घातों का योग होती है: \[n = x + y\]

चरण 2
घातों को जोड़ने पर: \[n = \frac{1}{2} + \frac{3}{2} = 2\]

चरण 3
अभिक्रिया की कुल कोटि 2 है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q04 - Half life calculation of first order reaction

questiontext.text:
A first-order reaction has a rate constant \(k = 5.5 \times 10^{-14}\ \text{s}^{-1}\). What is the half-life of this reaction?

एक प्रथम कोटि की अभिक्रिया का दर स्थिरांक \(k = 5.5 \times 10^{-14}\ \text{s}^{-1}\) है। इस अभिक्रिया का अर्ध-आयु काल क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
The half-life of a first-order reaction is given by: \[t_{1/2} = \frac{0.693}{k}\]

Step 2
Substituting \(k = 5.5 \times 10^{-14}\ \text{s}^{-1}\): \[t_{1/2} = \frac{0.693}{5.5 \times 10^{-14}\ \text{s}^{-1}} = 1.26 \times 10^{13}\ \text{s}\]

Step 3
The half-life is \(1.26 \times 10^{13}\ \text{s}\).

चरण 1
प्रथम कोटि अभिक्रिया के अर्ध-आयु काल का सूत्र है: \[t_{1/2} = \frac{0.693}{k}\]

चरण 2
\(k = 5.5 \times 10^{-14}\ \text{s}^{-1}\) रखने पर: \[t_{1/2} = \frac{0.693}{5.5 \times 10^{-14}} = 1.26 \times 10^{13}\ \text{s}\]

चरण 3
अर्ध-आयु काल का सही मान \(1.26 \times 10^{13}\ \text{s}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q05 - Reaction rate calculation with stoichiometric coefficient two

questiontext.text:
In the reaction \(2\text{A} \rightarrow \text{Products}\), the concentration of \(\text{A}\) decreases from \(0.50\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) to \(0.40\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) in \(10\ \text{minutes}\). What is the rate of reaction during this interval?

अभिक्रिया \(2\text{A} \rightarrow \text{उत्पाद}\) में, \(10\ \text{मिनट}\) में \(\text{A}\) की सांद्रता \(0.50\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) से घटकर \(0.40\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) हो जाती है। इस समयांतराल में अभिक्रिया की दर क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
For stoichiometric coefficient 2, reaction rate is: \[\text{Rate} = -\frac{1}{2} \frac{\Delta [\text{A}]}{\Delta t}\]

Step 2
Substituting \(\Delta [\text{A}] = 0.40 - 0.50 = -0.10\ \text{M}\) and \(\Delta t = 10\ \text{min}\): \[\text{Rate} = -\frac{1}{2} \left(\frac{-0.10}{10}\right) = \frac{0.010}{2} = 5.0 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\]

Step 3
The reaction rate is \(5.0 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
रससमीकरणमितीय संबंध: \[\text{दर} = -\frac{1}{2} \frac{\Delta [\text{A}]}{\Delta t}\]

चरण 2
मान रखने पर: \[\text{दर} = -\frac{1}{2} \left(\frac{0.40 - 0.50}{10}\right) = 5.0 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\]

चरण 3
अभिक्रिया की दर \(5.0 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q06 - Rate of formation of nitrogen dioxide product

questiontext.text:
During the decomposition \(2\text{N}_2\text{O}_5(g) \rightarrow 4\text{NO}_2(g) + \text{O}_2(g)\), the concentration of \(\text{N}_2\text{O}_5\) decreases from \(2.33\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) to \(2.08\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) in \(184\ \text{minutes}\). What is the rate of formation of \(\text{NO}_2\)?

अपघटन \(2\text{N}_2\text{O}_5(g) \rightarrow 4\text{NO}_2(g) + \text{O}_2(g)\) के दौरान, \(184\ \text{मिनट}\) में \(\text{N}_2\text{O}_5\) की सांद्रता \(2.33\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) से घटकर \(2.08\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) हो जाती है। \(\text{NO}_2\) के बनने की दर क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
The stoichiometric relation between disappearance of \(\text{N}_2\text{O}_5\) and appearance of \(\text{NO}_2\) is: \[-\frac{1}{2} \frac{\Delta [\text{N}_2\text{O}_5]}{\Delta t} = \frac{1}{4} \frac{\Delta [\text{NO}_2]}{\Delta t} \implies \frac{\Delta [\text{NO}_2]}{\Delta t} = 2 \left(-\frac{\Delta [\text{N}_2\text{O}_5]}{\Delta t}\right)\]

Step 2
Calculating the rate of disappearance: \[-\frac{\Delta [\text{N}_2\text{O}_5]}{\Delta t} = \frac{2.33 - 2.08}{184} = \frac{0.25}{184} = 1.359 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\] \[\frac{\Delta [\text{NO}_2]}{\Delta t} = 2 \times (1.359 \times 10^{-3}) = 2.72 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\]

Step 3
The rate of production of \(\text{NO}_2\) is \(2.72 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
रससमीकरणमितीय संबंध: \[\frac{\Delta [\text{NO}_2]}{\Delta t} = 2 \left(-\frac{\Delta [\text{N}_2\text{O}_5]}{\Delta t}\right)\]

चरण 2
\(\text{N}_2\text{O}_5\) के लुप्त होने की दर: \[-\frac{\Delta [\text{N}_2\text{O}_5]}{\Delta t} = \frac{0.25}{184} = 1.359 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{M}\ \text{min}^{-1}\] \[\frac{\Delta [\text{NO}_2]}{\Delta t} = 2 \times 1.359 \times 10^{-3} = 2.72 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\] /p>

चरण 3
\(\text{NO}_2\) के बनने की दर \(2.72 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{min}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q07 - Rate scaling factor upon concentration quadrupling

questiontext.text:
The gas-phase thermal decomposition of acetaldehyde follows the rate law \(\text{Rate} = k[\text{CH}_3\text{CHO}]^{3/2}\). By what factor will the reaction rate increase if the concentration of acetaldehyde is increased to 4 times its initial value?

ऐसीटैल्डिहाइड का गैसीय तापीय अपघटन दर नियम \(\text{दर} = k[\text{CH}_3\text{CHO}]^{3/2}\) का पालन करता है। यदि ऐसीटैल्डिहाइड की सांद्रता इसके प्रारंभिक मान की 4 गुनी कर दी जाए, तो अभिक्रिया की दर कितने गुना बढ़ जाएगी?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Initial rate is \(r_1 = k[\text{R}]^{3/2}\). When concentration is scaled by a factor of 4, \([\text{R}'] = 4[\text{R}]\).

Step 2
New rate \(r_2\) is: \[r_2 = k(4[\text{R}])^{3/2} = 4^{3/2} \cdot k[\text{R}]^{3/2} = (\sqrt{4})^3 r_1 = 2^3 r_1 = 8 r_1\]

Step 3
The reaction rate increases by a factor of 8.

चरण 1
प्रारंभिक दर \(r_1 = k[\text{R}]^{3/2}\) है। सांद्रता को 4 गुना करने पर \([\text{R}'] = 4[\text{R}]\)।

चरण 2
नई दर: \[r_2 = k(4[\text{R}])^{3/2} = 4^{3/2} r_1 = (\sqrt{4})^3 r_1 = 8 r_1\]

चरण 3
अभिक्रिया की दर 8 गुना बढ़ जाएगी।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q08 - Initial rate from third order rate law

questiontext.text:
For the reaction \(2\text{A} + \text{B} \rightarrow \text{A}_2\text{B}\), the rate law is \(\text{Rate} = k[\text{A}][\text{B}]^2\) with \(k = 2.0 \times 10^{-6}\ \text{mol}^{-2}\ \text{L}^2\ \text{s}^{-1}\). What is the initial reaction rate when \([\text{A}] = 0.10\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) and \([\text{B}] = 0.20\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\)?

अभिक्रिया \(2\text{A} + \text{B} \rightarrow \text{A}_2\text{B}\) के लिए दर नियम \(\text{दर} = k[\text{A}][\text{B}]^2\) है, जहाँ \(k = 2.0 \times 10^{-6}\ \text{mol}^{-2}\ \text{L}^2\ \text{s}^{-1}\) है। जब \([\text{A}] = 0.10\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) तथा \([\text{B}] = 0.20\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) हो, तो प्रारंभिक दर क्या होगी?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
The rate law expression is: \[\text{Rate} = k[\text{A}][\text{B}]^2\]

Step 2
Substituting given concentrations: \[\text{Rate} = (2.0 \times 10^{-6})(0.10)(0.20)^2 = (2.0 \times 10^{-6})(0.10)(0.040) = 8.0 \times 10^{-9}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\]

Step 3
The initial reaction rate is \(8.0 \times 10^{-9}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
दर नियम सूत्र: \[\text{दर} = k[\text{A}][\text{B}]^2\]

चरण 2
मान रखने पर: \[\text{दर} = (2.0 \times 10^{-6})(0.10)(0.20)^2 = 8.0 \times 10^{-9}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\]

चरण 3
प्रारंभिक अभिक्रिया दर \(8.0 \times 10^{-9}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q09 - Rate of hydrogen formation in ammonia decomposition

questiontext.text:
The decomposition of ammonia on a platinum surface, \(2\text{NH}_3(g) \xrightarrow{\text{Pt}} \text{N}_2(g) + 3\text{H}_2(g)\), is zero order with \(k = 2.5 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\). What is the rate of production of \(\text{H}_2\)?

प्लैटिनम की सतह पर अमोनिया का अपघटन, \(2\text{NH}_3(g) \xrightarrow{\text{Pt}} \text{N}_2(g) + 3\text{H}_2(g)\), शून्य कोटि की अभिक्रिया है जिसका दर स्थिरांक \(k = 2.5 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\) है। \(\text{H}_2\) के बनने की दर क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Reaction rate in terms of \(\text{H}_2\) production is: \[\text{Rate} = \frac{1}{3} \frac{\text{d}[\text{H}_2]}{\text{d}t} = k \implies \frac{\text{d}[\text{H}_2]}{\text{d}t} = 3k\]

Step 2
Substituting \(k = 2.5 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\): \[\frac{\text{d}[\text{H}_2]}{\text{d}t} = 3 \times (2.5 \times 10^{-4}) = 7.5 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\]

Step 3
The rate of production of \(\text{H}_2\) is \(7.5 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
रससमीकरणमितीय संबंध: \[\frac{\text{d}[\text{H}_2]}{\text{d}t} = 3k\]

चरण 2
\(k = 2.5 \times 10^{-4}\) रखने पर: \[\frac{\text{d}[\text{H}_2]}{\text{d}t} = 3 \times (2.5 \times 10^{-4}) = 7.5 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\]

चरण 3
\(\text{H}_2\) के उत्पादन की दर \(7.5 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q10 - Average rate in pseudo first order interval

questiontext.text:
In a pseudo first-order reaction in water, the concentration of reactant \(\text{A}\) is \(0.31\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) at \(t = 30\ \text{s}\) and \(0.17\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) at \(t = 60\ \text{s}\). What is the average reaction rate between \(30\) and \(60\ \text{seconds}\)?

जल में एक छद्म प्रथम कोटि की अभिक्रिया में, अभिकारक \(\text{A}\) की सांद्रता \(t = 30\ \text{s}\) पर \(0.31\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) तथा \(t = 60\ \text{s}\) पर \(0.17\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) है। \(30\) से \(60\ \text{सेकंड}\) के समयांतराल में औसत अभिक्रिया दर क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
The average rate between \(t_1\) and \(t_2\) is: \[r_{\text{av}} = -\frac{[\text{A}]_2 - [\text{A}]_1}{t_2 - t_1}\]

Step 2
Substituting \([\text{A}]_1 = 0.31\ \text{M}\), \([\text{A}]_2 = 0.17\ \text{M}\), \(\Delta t = 30\ \text{s}\): \[r_{\text{av}} = -\frac{0.17 - 0.31}{60 - 30} = \frac{0.14}{30} = 4.67 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\]

Step 3
The average rate during this interval is \(4.67 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
औसत दर सूत्र: \[r_{\text{av}} = -\frac{[\text{A}]_2 - [\text{A}]_1}{t_2 - t_1}\]

चरण 2
मान रखने पर: \[r_{\text{av}} = \frac{0.31 - 0.17}{60 - 30} = \frac{0.14}{30} = 4.67 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\]

चरण 3
औसत अभिक्रिया दर \(4.67 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\ \text{s}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q11 - Half life calculation for fast first order

questiontext.text:
The rate constant for a first-order chemical reaction is \(k = 200\ \text{s}^{-1}\). What is its half-life?

एक प्रथम कोटि रासायनिक अभिक्रिया के लिए दर स्थिरांक \(k = 200\ \text{s}^{-1}\) है। इसका अर्ध-आयु काल क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Half-life of a first-order reaction is: \[t_{1/2} = \frac{0.693}{k}\]

Step 2
Substituting \(k = 200\ \text{s}^{-1}\): \[t_{1/2} = \frac{0.693}{200\ \text{s}^{-1}} = 3.465 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{s} \approx 3.47 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{s}\]

Step 3
The half-life of the reaction is \(3.47 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{s}\).

चरण 1
अर्ध-आयु काल सूत्र: \[t_{1/2} = \frac{0.693}{k}\]

चरण 2
\(k = 200\) रखने पर: \[t_{1/2} = \frac{0.693}{200} = 3.47 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{s}\]

चरण 3
अर्ध-आयु काल \(3.47 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{s}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q12 - Time for sixteen fold concentration reduction first

questiontext.text:
The rate constant for a first-order reaction is \(60\ \text{s}^{-1}\). How much time will it take to reduce the initial concentration of the reactant to \(1/16^{\text{th}}\) of its initial value?

एक प्रथम कोटि अभिक्रिया का दर स्थिरांक \(60\ \text{s}^{-1}\) है। अभिकारक की प्रारंभिक सांद्रता को घटकर उसके प्रारंभिक मान का \(1/16\) भाग रहने में कितना समय लगेगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Reducing concentration to \(1/16 = (1/2)^4\) requires exactly 4 half-lives: \[t = 4 \times t_{1/2} = 4 \times \frac{0.693}{k}\]

Step 2
Substituting \(k = 60\ \text{s}^{-1}\): \[t = 4 \times \frac{0.693}{60} = 4 \times 0.01155\ \text{s} = 0.0462\ \text{s} = 4.62 \times 10^{-2}\ \text{s}\]

Step 3
The required time is \(4.62 \times 10^{-2}\ \text{s}\).

चरण 1
सांद्रता को \(1/16 = (1/2)^4\) तक घटने में 4 अर्ध-आयु काल लगते हैं: \[t = 4 \times \frac{0.693}{k}\]

चरण 2
\(k = 60\) रखने पर: \[t = 4 \times \frac{0.693}{60} = 0.0462\ \text{s} = 4.62 \times 10^{-2}\ \text{s}\]

चरण 3
आवश्यक समय \(4.62 \times 10^{-2}\ \text{s}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q13 - Remaining reactant concentration calculation after hundred seconds

questiontext.text:
For the first-order reaction \(\text{A} \rightarrow \text{Products}\), \(k = 2.0 \times 10^{-2}\ \text{s}^{-1}\). If initial concentration \([\text{A}]_0 = 1.0\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\), what concentration of \(\text{A}\) remains after \(100\ \text{s}\)? (Given: \(e^{-2} = 0.135\))

प्रथम कोटि अभिक्रिया \(\text{A} \rightarrow \text{उत्पाद}\) के लिए \(k = 2.0 \times 10^{-2}\ \text{s}^{-1}\) है। यदि प्रारंभिक सांद्रता \([\text{A}]_0 = 1.0\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) हो, तो \(100\ \text{s}\) पश्चात \(\text{A}\) की कितनी सांद्रता शेष बचेगी? (दिया गया है: \(e^{-2} = 0.135\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
The exponential first-order integrated rate law is: \[[\text{A}] = [\text{A}]_0 e^{-kt}\]

Step 2
Substituting \([\text{A}]_0 = 1.0\ \text{M}\), \(k = 0.020\ \text{s}^{-1}\), and \(t = 100\ \text{s}\): \[kt = (0.020)(100) = 2.0 \implies [\text{A}] = 1.0 \times e^{-2.0} = 0.135\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\]

Step 3
The concentration of \(\text{A}\) remaining after \(100\ \text{s}\) is \(0.135\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
प्रथम कोटि चरघातांकी समीकरण: \[[\text{A}] = [\text{A}]_0 e^{-kt}\]

चरण 2
मान रखने पर: \[[\text{A}] = 1.0 \times e^{-(0.020 \times 100)} = 1.0 \times e^{-2} = 0.135\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\]

चरण 3
शेष सांद्रता \(0.135\ \text{mol}\ \text{L}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q14 - Rate constant from sulfuryl chloride half life

questiontext.text:
The time required to decompose \(\text{SO}_2\text{Cl}_2\) to half its initial amount is \(60\ \text{minutes}\). If the decomposition is a first-order reaction, what is its rate constant in \(\text{s}^{-1}\)?

\(\text{SO}_2\text{Cl}_2\) को अपनी प्रारंभिक मात्रा से आधा अपघटित होने में \(60\ \text{मिनट}\) का समय लगता है। यदि यह एक प्रथम कोटि अभिक्रिया है, तो \(\text{s}^{-1}\) में इसका दर स्थिरांक क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Convert half-life to seconds: \[t_{1/2} = 60\ \text{min} \times 60\ \text{s}\ \text{min}^{-1} = 3600\ \text{s}\]

Step 2
Rate constant \(k\) is: \[k = \frac{0.693}{t_{1/2}} = \frac{0.693}{3600\ \text{s}} = 1.925 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{s}^{-1}\]

Step 3
The rate constant is \(1.925 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{s}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
अर्ध-आयु काल सेकंड में: \[t_{1/2} = 60 \times 60 = 3600\ \text{s}\]

चरण 2
दर स्थिरांक: \[k = \frac{0.693}{3600} = 1.925 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{s}^{-1}\]

चरण 3
दर स्थिरांक \(1.925 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{s}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q15 - Reaction orders from initial rate concentration data

questiontext.text:
In a reaction between \(\text{A}\) and \(\text{B}\), initial rate data were obtained:
Exp 1: \([\text{A}] = 0.20\ \text{M}\), \([\text{B}] = 0.30\ \text{M}\), \(r_0 = 5.07 \times 10^{-5}\ \text{M}\ \text{s}^{-1}\)
Exp 2: \([\text{A}] = 0.20\ \text{M}\), \([\text{B}] = 0.10\ \text{M}\), \(r_0 = 5.07 \times 10^{-5}\ \text{M}\ \text{s}^{-1}\)
Exp 3: \([\text{A}] = 0.40\ \text{M}\), \([\text{B}] = 0.05\ \text{M}\), \(r_0 = 1.43 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{M}\ \text{s}^{-1}\)
What are the reaction orders with respect to \(\text{A}\) and \(\text{B}\)? (Given: \(2^{1.5} \approx 2.82\))

\(\text{A}\) और \(\text{B}\) के बीच एक अभिक्रिया में निम्नलिखित प्रारंभिक दर आँकड़े प्राप्त हुए:
प्रयोग 1: \([\text{A}] = 0.20\ \text{M}\), \([\text{B}] = 0.30\ \text{M}\), \(r_0 = 5.07 \times 10^{-5}\ \text{M}\ \text{s}^{-1}\)
प्रयोग 2: \([\text{A}] = 0.20\ \text{M}\), \([\text{B}] = 0.10\ \text{M}\), \(r_0 = 5.07 \times 10^{-5}\ \text{M}\ \text{s}^{-1}\)
प्रयोग 3: \([\text{A}] = 0.40\ \text{M}\), \([\text{B}] = 0.05\ \text{M}\), \(r_0 = 1.43 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{M}\ \text{s}^{-1}\)
\(\text{A}\) और \(\text{B}\) के सापेक्ष अभिक्रिया की कोटियाँ क्या हैं? (दिया गया है: \(2^{1.5} \approx 2.82\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Comparing Exp 1 and Exp 2: \([\text{A}]\) is constant at \(0.20\ \text{M}\), while \([\text{B}]\) drops by a factor of 3 from \(0.30\ \text{M}\) to \(0.10\ \text{M}\). The rate \(r_0\) remains completely unchanged at \(5.07 \times 10^{-5}\ \text{M}\ \text{s}^{-1}\), so order with respect to \(\text{B}\) is 0.

Step 2
Since rate is independent of \([\text{B}]\), comparing Exp 3 and Exp 2 gives: \[\frac{r_3}{r_2} = \frac{1.43 \times 10^{-4}}{5.07 \times 10^{-5}} = 2.82 = \left(\frac{0.40}{0.20}\right)^x = 2^x \implies 2^x = 2.82 = 2^{1.5} \implies x = 1.5\]

Step 3
The order is 1.5 with respect to \(\text{A}\) and 0 with respect to \(\text{B}\).

चरण 1
प्रयोग 1 और 2 की तुलना करने पर: \([\text{A}]\) स्थिर रहने पर \([\text{B}]\) परिवर्तित होने पर भी दर नहीं बदलती, अतः \(\text{B}\) के सापेक्ष कोटि 0 है।

चरण 2
प्रयोग 3 और 2 की तुलना करने पर: \[\frac{1.43 \times 10^{-4}}{5.07 \times 10^{-5}} = 2.82 = \left(\frac{0.40}{0.20}\right)^x = 2^x \implies x = 1.5\]

चरण 3
\(\text{A}\) के सापेक्ष कोटि 1.5 तथा \(\text{B}\) के सापेक्ष कोटि 0 है।

answer.text: Order with respect to A = 1, order with respect to B = 1
Order with respect to A = 2, order with respect to B = 0
Order with respect to A = 1.5, order with respect to B = 0
Order with respect to A = 1, order with respect to B = 0

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q16 - Time calculation for mass reduction first order

questiontext.text:
A first-order reaction has rate constant \(k = 1.15 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{s}^{-1}\). How long will it take for \(5.0\ \text{g}\) of this reactant to be reduced to \(3.0\ \text{g}\)? (Given: \(\log 1.667 = 0.222\))

एक प्रथम कोटि की अभिक्रिया का दर स्थिरांक \(k = 1.15 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{s}^{-1}\) है। इस अभिकारक के \(5.0\ \text{g}\) को घटकर \(3.0\ \text{g}\) होने में कितना समय लगेगा? (दिया गया है: \(\log 1.667 = 0.222\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
The integrated first-order logarithmic equation is: \[t = \frac{2.303}{k} \log \frac{[\text{R}]_0}{[\text{R}]}\]

Step 2
With \([\text{R}]_0/[\text{R}] = 5.0/3.0 = 1.667\) and \(\log 1.667 = 0.222\): \[t = \frac{2.303}{1.15 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{s}^{-1}} \times 0.222 = (2002.6) \times 0.222 \approx 444.6\ \text{s} \approx 444\ \text{s}\]

Step 3
The time required is \(444\ \text{s}\).

चरण 1
प्रथम कोटि समाकलित समीकरण: \[t = \frac{2.303}{k} \log \frac{[\text{R}]_0}{[\text{R}]}\]

चरण 2
मान रखने पर: \[t = \frac{2.303}{1.15 \times 10^{-3}} \log\left(\frac{5.0}{3.0}\right) = 2002.6 \times 0.222 \approx 444\ \text{s}\]

चरण 3
आवश्यक समय \(444\ \text{s}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q17 - Radiocarbon dating archaeological wood sample age estimation

questiontext.text:
The half-life for radioactive decay of \(^{14}\text{C}\) is \(5730\ \text{years}\). An archaeological wood artifact contains \(80\%\) of the \(^{14}\text{C}\) found in living wood. What is the estimated age of the artifact? (Given: \(\log 1.25 = 0.0969\))

\(^{14}\text{C}\) के रेडियोऐक्टिव क्षय की अर्ध-आयु \(5730\ \text{वर्ष}\) है। एक पुरातात्विक काष्ठ कलाकृति में जीवित वृक्ष की तुलना में केवल \(80\%\) \(^{14}\text{C}\) शेष है। नमूने की अनुमानित आयु क्या है? (दिया गया है: \(\log 1.25 = 0.0969\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
First-order radioactive decay constant is: \[k = \frac{0.693}{t_{1/2}} = \frac{0.693}{5730\ \text{years}} = 1.2094 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{year}^{-1}\]

Step 2
For \([\text{R}] = 0.80 [\text{R}]_0\), the ratio is \([\text{R}]_0/[\text{R}] = 100/80 = 1.25\): \[t = \frac{2.303}{k} \log(1.25) = \frac{2.303 \times 0.0969}{1.2094 \times 10^{-4}} = \frac{0.22316}{1.2094 \times 10^{-4}} \approx 1845\ \text{years}\]

Step 3
The estimated age of the wood artifact is \(1845\ \text{years}\).

चरण 1
क्षय दर स्थिरांक: \[k = \frac{0.693}{5730} = 1.2094 \times 10^{-4}\ \text{वर्ष}^{-1}\]

चरण 2
\(80\%\) शेष रहने पर: \[t = \frac{2.303}{1.2094 \times 10^{-4}} \log(1.25) = \frac{2.303 \times 0.0969}{1.2094 \times 10^{-4}} \approx 1845\ \text{वर्ष}\]

चरण 3
नमूने की आयु लगभग \(1845\ \text{वर्ष}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q18 - Half life from fractional decomposition time period

questiontext.text:
A first-order reaction takes \(40\ \text{minutes}\) for \(30\%\) decomposition of the reactant. What is the half-life (\(t_{1/2}\)) of this reaction? (Given: \(\log 1.4286 = 0.1549\))

एक प्रथम कोटि की अभिक्रिया में अभिकारक के \(30\%\) अपघटन के लिए \(40\ \text{मिनट}\) का समय लगता है। इस अभिक्रिया का अर्ध-आयु काल (\(t_{1/2}\)) क्या है? (दिया गया है: \(\log 1.4286 = 0.1549\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
For \(30\%\) decomposition, \([\text{R}] = 0.70 [\text{R}]_0\). Rate constant \(k\) is: \[k = \frac{2.303}{t} \log \frac{[\text{R}]_0}{[\text{R}]} = \frac{2.303}{40} \log\left(\frac{100}{70}\right) = \frac{2.303 \times 0.1549}{40} = 8.918 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{min}^{-1}\]

Step 2
Half-life is: \[t_{1/2} = \frac{0.693}{k} = \frac{0.693}{8.918 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{min}^{-1}} \approx 77.7\ \text{min}\]

Step 3
The half-life of the reaction is \(77.7\ \text{min}\).

चरण 1
\(30\%\) अपघटन पर शेष सांद्रता \(70\%\) है: \[k = \frac{2.303}{40} \log\left(\frac{100}{70}\right) = \frac{2.303 \times 0.1549}{40} = 8.918 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{min}^{-1}\]

चरण 2
अर्ध-आयु काल: \[t_{1/2} = \frac{0.693}{8.918 \times 10^{-3}} \approx 77.7\ \text{min}\]

चरण 3
अभिक्रिया का अर्ध-आयु काल \(77.7\ \text{मिनट}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q19 - Activation energy from rate quadrupling with temperature

questiontext.text:
The rate of a chemical reaction quadruples when the temperature changes from \(293\ \text{K}\) to \(313\ \text{K}\). What is the activation energy of the reaction? (Given: \(R = 8.314\ \text{J}\ \text{K}^{-1}\ \text{mol}^{-1}\), \(\log 4 = 0.6021\))

जब तापमान \(293\ \text{K}\) से \(313\ \text{K}\) हो जाता है, तो एक रासायनिक अभिक्रिया की दर चार गुनी हो जाती है। अभिक्रिया की सक्रियण ऊर्जा क्या है? (दिया गया है: \(R = 8.314\ \text{J}\ \text{K}^{-1}\ \text{mol}^{-1}\), \(\log 4 = 0.6021\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
The Arrhenius two-temperature equation is: \[\log \frac{k_2}{k_1} = \frac{E_a}{2.303 R} \left(\frac{T_2 - T_1}{T_1 T_2}\right)\]

Step 2
Substituting \(k_2/k_1 = 4\), \(T_1 = 293\ \text{K}\), \(T_2 = 313\ \text{K}\): \[0.6021 = \frac{E_a}{19.147} \times \left(\frac{20}{293 \times 313}\right) = \frac{E_a}{19.147} \times \left(\frac{20}{91709}\right)\] \[E_a = \frac{0.6021 \times 19.147 \times 91709}{20} \approx 52863\ \text{J}\ \text{mol}^{-1} = 52.9\ \text{kJ}\ \text{mol}^{-1}\]

Step 3
The activation energy is \(52.9\ \text{kJ}\ \text{mol}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
आर्रेनियस समीकरण: \[\log \frac{k_2}{k_1} = \frac{E_a}{2.303 R} \left(\frac{T_2 - T_1}{T_1 T_2}\right)\]

चरण 2
मान रखने पर: \[0.6021 = \frac{E_a}{19.147} \times \left(\frac{20}{91709}\right) \implies E_a = \frac{0.6021 \times 19.147 \times 91709}{20} \approx 52.9\ \text{kJ}\ \text{mol}^{-1}\]

चरण 3
सक्रियण ऊर्जा \(52.9\ \text{kJ}\ \text{mol}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_CHEMICAL_KINETICS_MCQ_Q20 - Activation energy from Arrhenius exponential temperature ratio

questiontext.text:
The rate constant for the decomposition of a hydrocarbon follows the equation \(k = (4.5 \times 10^{11}\ \text{s}^{-1}) e^{-28000\ \text{K} / T}\). What is the activation energy \(E_a\) of this reaction? (Given: \(R = 8.314\ \text{J}\ \text{K}^{-1}\ \text{mol}^{-1}\))

एक हाइड्रोकार्बन के अपघटन के लिए दर स्थिरांक समीकरण \(k = (4.5 \times 10^{11}\ \text{s}^{-1}) e^{-28000\ \text{K} / T}\) का पालन करता है। इस अभिक्रिया की सक्रियण ऊर्जा \(E_a\) क्या है? (दिया गया है: \(R = 8.314\ \text{J}\ \text{K}^{-1}\ \text{mol}^{-1}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1
Comparing the given expression with the standard Arrhenius equation \(k = A e^{-E_a / RT}\): \[\frac{E_a}{RT} = \frac{28000\ \text{K}}{T} \implies \frac{E_a}{R} = 28000\ \text{K}\]

Step 2
Solving for \(E_a\) with \(R = 8.314\ \text{J}\ \text{K}^{-1}\ \text{mol}^{-1}\): \[E_a = 28000\ \text{K} \times 8.314\ \text{J}\ \text{K}^{-1}\ \text{mol}^{-1} = 232792\ \text{J}\ \text{mol}^{-1} = 232.79\ \text{kJ}\ \text{mol}^{-1} \approx 232.8\ \text{kJ}\ \text{mol}^{-1}\]

Step 3
The activation energy of the reaction is \(232.8\ \text{kJ}\ \text{mol}^{-1}\).

चरण 1
मानक आर्रेनियस समीकरण \(k = A e^{-E_a / RT}\) से तुलना करने पर: \[\frac{E_a}{R} = 28000\ \text{K}\]

चरण 2
\(E_a\) की गणना: \[E_a = 28000 \times 8.314 = 232792\ \text{J}\ \text{mol}^{-1} \approx 232.8\ \text{kJ}\ \text{mol}^{-1}\]

चरण 3
सक्रियण ऊर्जा का सही मान \(232.8\ \text{kJ}\ \text{mol}^{-1}\) है।
